clips.title: The story
paras: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz is a goblin dockhand working the heavy machinery at the port of Ratchet. After an overloaded crane mishap scattered cargo across the docks, he finds himself desperate to recover a valuable stolen bottle before his superiors notice.

Like many goblin dockworkers, Crane Operator Bigglefuzz prioritized efficiency and haste over basic safety margins. While attempting to hoist an excessively heavy haul from a merchant vessel, his crane buckled, sending crates crashing down across the Ratchet wharves. In the ensuing chaos, opportunistic scoundrels swept in, leaving Bigglefuzz to scramble to clean up the mess and salvage the most precious goods before Gazlowe or the local port masters dock his pay.

The worst casualty of the accident was not the broken wood, but a crate containing rare ninety-nine-year-old port. Before Bigglefuzz could secure the spill, an elusive vagrant named Mad Magglish snatched a bottle and fled into hiding, threatening to leave Bigglefuzz answering for an irreplaceable loss.
